Maya (infra): Morning — saw eu-west GPU pools go from 8 -> 70 -> 5 over ~12m. Cost spike ~40% for 55m. CA logs show repeated scaleUp for same group.
Oliver: Same. CA triggered aggressively on short-lived batch jobs. We need guardrails.
Priya: The jobs are tiny (20-120s). CA thinks demand is sustained. We should stop scaling for microbursts.
Hugo: Two approaches: tune CA timing and/or introduce a "stabilizer" that watches queue depth and suggests minimums for GPU pools.
Maya (infra): CA flag ideas (canary first):

```
--scan-interval=15s
--scale-up-delay=60s
--max-node-provision-time=10m
--scale-down-unneeded-time=12m
--expander=random
```

Would reduce noise but still not ideal.
Priya: Stabilizer concept:
- read pending GPU job count (from k8s CRD or queue)
- when pending > T for W seconds -> POST desired-min to cluster via annotation or TF var
- cooldown between updates
- dry-run mode first

API: POST /stabilizer/v1/suggest {"nodepool":"gpu-eu-west","min":12,"ttl":600}
Hugo: Terraform snippet for nodepool module to accept dynamic min annotation:

```
resource "kubernetes_node_pool" "gpu" {
  name = var.name
  min_size = var.base_min
  max_size = var.base_max
  metadata {
    annotations = merge(var.extra_annotations, local.dynamic_annotations)
  }
}
```

Controller will map annotation redwood.com/dynamic-min -> nodegroup min.
Oliver: Helm changes for CA (eu-west canary):

```
clusterAutoscaler:
  extraArgs:
    scan-interval: 15s
    scale-up-delay: 60s
    max-node-provision-time: 10m
  nodeSelector:
    pool: gpu
```

Make it opt-in per nodepool.
Maya (infra): Important: stabilizer should avoid fighting warm pools and pre-warmed instances. Check warm-pool occupancy before raising min.
Nora: Also make sure we don't push spot->on-demand conversions. If stabilizer would cause expensive on-demand scale, it should abort.
Priya: Implementation plan:
- PoC stabilizer service (k8s Deployment) that monitors queue and warm-pool metrics
- Expose dry-run + suggest endpoints
- Canary in eu-west on spot-backed gpu pool

InfraBot: [deploy-bot] Canary deploy started: infra/stabilizer v0.1 -> eu-west-1
Hugo: Observability: emit metrics: suggested_min, active_min, queue_depth, triggered_at; hook to cost alerting.
Oliver: Ops runbook: how to roll back, how to disable if cost > 20% delta.
Maya (infra): Action items:
- Maya: TF PR to accept extra_annotations and example for dynamic-min (eu-west canary)
- Oliver: CA helm values PR + dry-run deploy
- Priya: PoC stabilizer container + README + canary schedule
Timeline: target canary Tue 06:00 UTC during low traffic window.
